target_customer: HR teams and managers at mid-size and large companies
problem: Annual performance reviews give employees little feedback. Impraise offered continuous feedback, 360 reviews, goals and check-ins to replace them.
product_category: Performance management and employee feedback software

founders.name: Bas Kohnke
founders.background_notes: YC page describes B2B SaaS, product and enterprise sales experience; no employers or schools named.

founders.name: Filipe Dobreira
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder and CTO on the YC page; no background found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Web app for feedback requests, reviews and goals, plus HR system integrations. Standard SaaS engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Review history and HR integrations give mild lock-in, but many similar tools existed and features were easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents did not buy it. In 2021 BetterUp, a coaching company, acquired it with terms undisclosed.

market_need_then: In 2016 the CEO told TechCrunch that many firms still ran reviews in Word or Excel and that employees lacked feedback; early customers included Atlassian and Booking.com.

brand_strength.rationale: Moderate B2B recognition among HR tech comparisons but no brand pages, interviews or community evidence found.

outcome_analysis: Impraise went through YC in 2014, signed enterprise customers by 2016, raised a 1.6 million dollar seed in 2016 and a 10.6 million dollar Series A in 2018, then laid off staff in a restructuring after the round. It was acquired by BetterUp in September 2021 on undisclosed terms, a soft exit in a crowded HR performance market, not a clear breakout.
notes: No company website listed on the YC page; treated as unavailable. No competitor source dated near the 2014 batch was found; the 2016 TechCrunch competitor list is not used. Branding search found nothing. Aggregators disagree on headquarters. Series A lead named Keen in most sources, HenQ in one.
